title: Public relay route parser
responsibility: Recognizes the relay’s public endpoints from exact method and validated path parts.

inputs.name: publicRoute.method
inputs.description: HTTP method used in exact route lookup. Matching is case-sensitive: GET serves health, connect, and pairing information; POST serves the three pairing actions.

inputs.name: publicRoute.pathname
inputs.description: Pathname supplied for route matching. Only the exact health path or host paths with recognized suffixes and identifiers matching the imported host and pairing patterns produce a route; query strings are not parsed separately.

outputs.name: publicRoute
outputs.description: A recognized route object, or undefined for every other method and pathname pair. Returned paths are reconstructed from the validated components.
